content.citation_notes: LangChain documents short-term and long-term memory concepts, including LangGraph long-term memories stored as JSON documents under namespaces and keys.；Letta documents persistent memory blocks that are always visible in the agent context window.；Mem0 separates memory into layers so agents remember the right detail at the right time and avoid over-fetching.；OWASP recommends validating and sanitizing data before storing agent memory, isolating memory, setting expiration and size limits, auditing sensitive data, and using cryptographic integrity checks.；Defines MemoryItem v0.1, memory types, lifecycle, source, write_policy, security, retrieval and integrity fields.

content.citation_notes: OWASP Agent Memory Guard protects AI agents from memory poisoning, persistent memory corruption, data exfiltration and malicious behavior across sessions.；Unit 42 demonstrates a proof of concept where indirect prompt injection silently poisons long-term agent memory and persists malicious instructions across sessions.；OWASP recommends validating and sanitizing data before storing agent memory, isolating memory, setting expiration and size limits, auditing sensitive data, and using cryptographic integrity checks.；LangChain documents short-term and long-term memory concepts, including LangGraph long-term memories stored as JSON documents under namespaces and keys.；Defines MemoryItem v0.1, memory types, lifecycle, source, write_policy, security, retrieval and integrity fields.

content.citation_notes: OWASP Agent Memory Guard protects AI agents from memory poisoning, persistent memory corruption, data exfiltration and malicious behavior across sessions.；Unit 42 demonstrates a proof of concept where indirect prompt injection silently poisons long-term agent memory and persists malicious instructions across sessions.；OWASP recommends validating and sanitizing data before storing agent memory, isolating memory, setting expiration and size limits, auditing sensitive data, and using cryptographic integrity checks.；LangChain documents short-term and long-term memory concepts, including LangGraph long-term memories stored as JSON documents under namespaces and keys.；Defines MemoryItem v0.1, memory types, lifecycle, source, write_policy, security, retrieval and integrity fields.

content.citation_notes: NIST AI RMF supports AI risk governance across design, development, use, evaluation, and monitoring.；OWASP LLM Top 10 covers prompt injection, training data poisoning, supply chain vulnerabilities, excessive agency, overreliance, and sensitive information disclosure.；MITRE ATLAS supports adversarial AI threat taxonomy and real-world AI attack observations.；OWASP GenAI Security Project covers LLM/agent security risks including prompt injection, memory/context poisoning and agentic application risks. It supports using a threat-model and mitigation framing rather than treating LLM/agent output as trusted authority.；NIST AI RMF supports AI risk governance across the AI lifecycle and reinforces provenance, accountability, monitoring and risk management framing.；MCP server 是只读专业知识访问层；默认 read_knowledge/read_sources/read_conflict_status 为 true，write_knowledge、approve_knowledge、trade、read_account、read_secret 为 false。工具不得暴露 secrets、API keys、account data、raw orders 或 private project facts；confirmed unresolved conflicts must block authoritative guidance。；MemoryItem v0.1 包含 source、relations、lifecycle、review、write_policy、security、retrieval、integrity 字段。AI 只能创建 proposed memory；active 必须由人工、规则引擎或受控审核流程设置；不允许静默覆盖 active memory；deprecated/rejected memory 不得作为当前事实默认注入。；search_memory/get_memory 为只读；propose_memory 只能提交 status=proposed 且 review_required=true；update_memory_status 和 supersede_memory 属于受控写入，并必须产生 audit_event_id。；表格/统计模型负责 numeric scoring；Qwen3/LLM 负责审计解释、reason code、RAG 引用、缺字段检查和人工复核摘要；Deterministic Final Gate 负责最终交易权限、阻断、降级、仓位上限、安全停机和审计追踪。scorer_output 不能包含 allow/block/size/kill_switch；LLM 不允许最终 gate。

content.citation_notes: CISA SBOM guidance supports software component inventory and supply-chain transparency.；CISA AI SBOM guidance supports AI component transparency and traceability for AI systems.；OWASP LLM Top 10 covers prompt injection, training data poisoning, supply chain vulnerabilities, excessive agency, overreliance, and sensitive information disclosure.；Model cards support documenting intended use, limitations, and evaluation conditions.；CycloneDX ML-BOM represents critical information about AI/ML models, datasets, dependencies, dataset provenance, training methodologies and AI framework configuration, supporting transparency and risk assessment.；SPDX AI Profile is designed to document and share information about AI software packages/systems and defines concepts/data elements for AI system and model artifacts, including models and datasets.；NIST AI RMF supports maintaining training data provenance and decision attribution to improve transparency and accountability.；CompositeReleaseUnit 绑定 numeric_model_version、calibrator_version、threshold_policy_version、prompt_version、rag_index_version、rag_snapshot_hash、llm_model_version、final_gate_policy_version 和 code_version_hash；CompositeArtifactReleaseManifest 记录 model_artifact_uri、calibrator_artifact_uri、prompt_registry_uri、rag_index_uri、threshold_policy_uri、final_gate_policy_uri、rollback target 和 kill switch policy。；ReleaseSafetyChecklist 包含 rollback_target_present、kill_switch_policy_present、kill_switch_tested_at、rollback_drill_status、secret_scan_status、human_approval_record_ref 和 monitoring_plan_ref。kill switch 是发布控制，不是交易策略逻辑；secret scan 不得保存密钥正文；rollback drill 不等于自动上线许可。；数据库契约要求 scoring/gating 决策绑定 audit_trace_id；模型、prompt、RAG、数据集、feature snapshot、release manifest 等版本必须作为可追踪 manifest 或引用保存，final_gate/score_result/llm_audit_result 默认 append-only。

content.citation_notes: CFA explains implementation shortfall, explicit and implicit trading costs, market impact, delay cost, opportunity cost, and benchmark limitations in electronic markets.；CFA describes trade cost analysis, execution quality, trading policies, escalation procedures, venue/partner selection, and post-trade evaluation.；FINRA Rule 5310 requires reasonable diligence to ascertain the best market and obtain favorable execution under prevailing market conditions.；QuantConnect fill modeling docs support the boundary that execution assumptions, fills, slippage, and fees are modeled components rather than strategy edge.；Bailey et al. propose a framework to estimate probability of backtest overfitting in investment simulations, supporting independent validation before promoting claims.；White's Reality Check addresses data-snooping risk when the same data is reused for inference or model selection.

source: CFA/QuantConnect 支撑 execution cost/fill/slippage 边界；Bailey/White 支撑过拟合和 data snooping 边界。
content: 本条不证明任何 execution feature 具有 alpha；只要求若主张 alpha 必须独立验证。
boundary: 低滑点、VWAP outperform、routing improvement 默认只能解释 implementation cost。

metadata.classification_notes: Phase 45 Layered Risk formal reviewed/caveat_only；只用于风控设计、owner 边界、证据字段和审计提醒，不是 approved/default guidance/hard gate，不生成交易许可、资金充足性结论、风控阈值、信用额度或保证金比例。

applies_when: 外接项目需要设计 pre-trade controls、信用/资本限额、订单量/价格控制、消息节流、保证金/抵押品边界或 post-trade surveillance 分工。
AI IDE 需要判断风险字段、owner、证据和 gate 位置是否被混淆。
需要把策略信号、资金/信用约束、交易所控制和风险复核分开建模。
not_applicable_when: 用户要求具体风险阈值、信用额度、保证金比例、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈或实盘交易动作。
需要外接 broker、clearing firm、exchange 或账户的实时事实时，应由外接项目事实层提供。
需要法律合规结论时，应由对应辖区合规/法律 owner 判断。

content.statement: 最大订单数量、价格 band/collar、fat-finger 检查和明显错误订单过滤是订单准入与市场完整性控制，必须声明数据源、venue/product 适用范围、拒单/复核行为和 owner；不能把策略信号强度当作绕过价格或数量控制的理由。
content.rationale: 本候选只定义分层风控、信用、保证金和 pre-trade/post-trade owner 边界，不输出风险阈值、交易参数或实盘执行建议。
procedure: 确认问题属于 Layered Risk / Credit / Margin、pre-trade controls、credit/capital exposure、order admission、message pressure、account/margin/collateral evidence 或 post-trade surveillance。
检查每个风控字段是否声明 owner、evidence_source_id、policy_version、decision_time、result、action_semantics 和 audit_trace_id。
若涉及 broker/venue/account 字段，必须保留 product_scope、account_mode、field_name、source timestamp、snapshot_id、staleness_status、semantic_boundary 和 owner。
若出现 unavailable、stale、unknown，不得静默视为 pass、资金充足或可下单。
若外接项目需要拒单、停机、撤单、解锁或下单许可，必须由外接项目 Risk Management / Live Execution owner 的 deterministic policy 定义。
返回知识时必须携带 source_evidence、review_status、machine_gate、适用范围、不适用场景和 owner 边界。
anti_patterns: 把 SEC、CME、IBKR、Binance 或 FIA 来源泛化为所有市场或所有 broker。
把 available funds、buying power、excess liquidity、wallet balance、available balance、margin balance、collateral、performance bond 互相等同。
把任一账户字段默认解释为可交易现金。
输出风险阈值、信用额度、保证金比例、资金充足性结论、下单许可、买卖点、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈或实盘执行建议。
把 reviewed/caveat_only 当作 approved、default guidance 或 hard gate。
把 post-trade surveillance 当作 pre-trade controls 的替代品。
validation: source_evidence 至少包含监管/交易所/券商/清算/平台来源，并明确来源适用边界。
若涉及 RISK05，必须包含 point-in-time account/margin/collateral evidence 契约或等价字段说明。
review.review_status 必须为 reviewed；approved/default guidance/hard gate/risk_threshold_advice 必须为 false。
machine_gate.default_guidance 必须为 caveat_only，且 visible_in_default_guidance_queue=false。
不得出现资金充足性结论、信用额度、保证金比例、可用资金判断或下单许可。
risk_notes: Layered Risk reviewed/caveat_only 只能作为风控设计、owner 边界和证据审计上下文。
监管来源具有辖区边界；broker/venue/platform 来源具有账户类型、产品和 API 语义边界。
AI Engineering 只能引用 reason code 和 evidence，不拥有阈值或执行动作。
本条不是 approved，不进入默认指导，不启用 hard gate。
content.citation_notes: SEC FAQ explains that controls should systematically limit financial exposure, prevent orders beyond credit/capital thresholds, reject orders beyond price/size parameters, and keep financial controls under broker-dealer control.；CME price banding subjects orders to price validation and rejects orders outside the given band to prevent erroneous or market-moving orders.；CME describes pre-trade risk tools including order blocking, cancel open orders, cancel-on-disconnect, self-match prevention, duplicate order checks, and real-time activity monitoring.；FIA best-practice paper covers pre-trade risk management, exchange volatility controls, post-trade analysis, testing, conformance, and system safeguards for automated trading.

source: CME price banding 只能作为 venue-specific 示例，不得泛化为所有 venue。
content: 最大订单量、price collar、price band 和 fat-finger controls 必须声明 venue/product/version/evidence。
boundary: 策略信号强度、AI 置信度或 alpha 分数不得作为绕过 order admission controls 的理由。
conflict: order admission controls 归 Live Execution / Risk Management owner。

assumptions: Layered Risk Controls 是交易工程设计和审计上下文，不是策略 alpha。
所有 credit、margin、price band、message-rate 和 surveillance 来源必须声明 venue、broker、clearing、jurisdiction 或 platform caveat。
候选通过 reviewed 审计前不能进入正式 reviewed 知识库。

source_evidence.evidence_summary: SEC FAQ explains that controls should systematically limit financial exposure, prevent orders beyond credit/capital thresholds, reject orders beyond price/size parameters, and keep financial controls under broker-dealer control.
limitations: FAQ guidance for SEC Rule 15c3-5; not a source for CEK-TA-specific field names.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: CME price banding subjects orders to price validation and rejects orders outside the given band to prevent erroneous or market-moving orders.
limitations: CME documentation; price bands are venue/product specific and not CEK-TA default thresholds.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: CME describes pre-trade risk tools including order blocking, cancel open orders, cancel-on-disconnect, self-match prevention, duplicate order checks, and real-time activity monitoring.
limitations: CME Globex-specific toolset; not applicable to all venues.

source_evidence.source_title: Best Practices for Automated Trading Risk Controls and System Safeguards
source_evidence.evidence_summary: FIA best-practice paper covers pre-trade risk management, exchange volatility controls, post-trade analysis, testing, conformance, and system safeguards for automated trading.
limitations: Industry best practices; not a binding rule and not a CEK-TA threshold source.
正式 reviewed 前必须由外部审计确认 claim 没有超出来源可证明范围。
监管、交易所、broker 和清算来源必须保留辖区、venue 和产品边界。
内部字段契约若后续用于 reviewed，需要提供 schema extract 或 contract hash。

reasons: SEC price/size parameter controls 和 CME price banding/pre-trade risk tools 足以支撑 order admission controls 独立于策略信号。

source: CME price banding 只能作为 venue-specific 示例，不得泛化为所有 venue。

conflict: order admission controls 归 Live Execution / Risk Management owner。

allowed: 用于提醒 AI IDE 设计分层风控、owner 边界、证据字段和审计 checklist。

content.citation_notes: CME explains futures order types such as market, limit, stop and GTC-style validity and warns participants to understand available order conditions.；Nasdaq order type and modifier guide documents TIF behavior such as market-hours IOC, system-hours IOC and order-type availability caveats.；Coinbase trading rules define limit, market, stop, TWAP, TIF, post-only, maker/taker and fee behavior with platform caveats.；Binance Futures order API documents order type, timeInForce, reduceOnly, selfTradePreventionMode and GTD goodTillDate behavior.；Kraken futures API documents limit, post-only, IOC, market, stop, take-profit, trailing-stop and FOK order types, plus reduceOnly behavior.；Nasdaq opening/closing crosses FAQ documents MOO/MOC, LOO/LOC, imbalance-only and auction-specific behavior and cutoffs.；NYSE auction fact sheet documents MOC/LOC order-entry cutoff and closing auction behavior.；NYSE Pillar documentation describes peg-order and auction participation differences as venue-specific behavior.；CME definitions cover limit order, market-with-protection order and hidden quantity order semantics.；CME FirmSoft order type definitions list MKL as Market Limit and support treating Market Limit / market-to-limit as CME-specific order semantics.；IBKR documents VWAP Best-Efforts as an IB Algo order type available for specified instruments and time periods, supporting VWAP as broker-specific execution algorithm semantics.

content.statement: 交易系统不能只用 market、limit、stop、stop-limit、iceberg、auction、TWAP/VWAP 等字符串枚举表示订单语义；每个订单类型必须声明适用 venue、产品、触发条件、价格保护、部分成交、拒单/过期状态、订单状态机映射和 ExecutionReport 证据边界。
content.rationale: 本候选只定义 live execution adapter / venue order semantics 的审计边界，不输出交易动作、费用优化或风控阈值。

把某个 venue 的订单行为泛化为所有市场通用规则。

validation: source_evidence 必须包含协议、交易所、broker 或 venue 官方来源，并明确来源适用边界。

content.citation_notes: FIX protocol provides standardized order-entry and execution-report message semantics used by many electronic trading integrations.；FIX Execution Report supports receipt, status, fill, cancel, replace and reject semantics for order-event lifecycle review.；CME explains futures order types such as market, limit, stop and GTC-style validity and warns participants to understand available order conditions.；Coinbase trading rules define limit, market, stop, TWAP, TIF, post-only, maker/taker and fee behavior with platform caveats.；Kraken futures API documents limit, post-only, IOC, market, stop, take-profit, trailing-stop and FOK order types, plus reduceOnly behavior.；FIX order-state guidance supports using ExecType and OrdStatus to drive order lifecycle state changes.

content.citation_notes: Databento status schema covers trading status, halt, pause, auction, matching-engine status and instrument expiration events.；OKX describes pre-market perpetuals, no expiration/delivery and early trading before official listing or spot launch.；Binance states ADL is the final step in liquidation and occurs if futures insurance funds cannot accept a bankrupt position.；Binance describes futures insurance funds as safety nets that limit the impact of liquidations and bankrupt positions.；Binance states aggregate trade streams include only market trades and exclude insurance fund and ADL trades.；Binance WebSocket market streams document ping/pong, disconnect behavior, message limits and stream limits.；Binance WebSocket API notes that a single connection is valid for 24 hours and ping/pong failure leads to disconnection.；Binance publishes scheduled maintenance and upgrade notices that can affect services.；Bybit recommends sending ping heartbeat packets every 20 seconds to maintain WebSocket connections.；Binance Mark Price API exposes markPrice, indexPrice, lastFundingRate, nextFundingTime and time, supporting mark-price monitoring fields.；OKX status page provides service-status and incident/maintenance context for exchange availability checks.；Bybit mark price documentation includes mark/index calculation context and abnormal/fallback handling cues for index components.；Binance official announcement provides incident-style context for service stability and market-volatility reviews.

content.citation_notes: Databento documents supported market-data schemas and field dictionaries such as MBO, MBP, trades, bars, definitions and statistics.；Databento instrument definitions provide point-in-time reference information including symbol, name, listing, expiration, tick size and strike price.；Databento statistics include session fields such as upper and lower price limits, settlement and venue-specific volume/price fields.；Nasdaq Symbol Directory defines fields such as round lot size, test issue and symbol directory metadata.；CEK-TA internal contract defines vendor_id, dataset_id, schema_version, parser_version, normalization_version, raw_snapshot_uri, raw_snapshot_digest and lineage_id.；OpenLineage dataset facets support attaching common, input and output metadata to datasets for lineage events.；OpenLineage object model links jobs, runs and input/output datasets to create lineage graphs across platforms.；MLflow Dataset Tracking supports tracking, versioning and managing datasets for training, validation and evaluation with lineage from raw data to predictions.；MLflow Dataset includes name, digest, schema, profile and source information for a dataset.；Iceberg snapshots and manifest lists record table state and metadata about manifests and data files.；DVC pipelines capture, organize, version and reproduce data science and machine learning workflows.

content.statement: Trading AI 项目应默认保留中央 canonical registry / audit ledger 作为 unit、dataset、manifest、feature schema、audit trace、readiness 和 lineage 的事实索引与治理入口。AI Trader、Unit 或策略版本默认通过 unit_id、unit_version、strategy_id、strategy_version 等字段逻辑隔离；当合规隔离、客户密钥、监管边界、地域隔离、超大规模或运维约束成立时，可以采用物理分库、schema 隔离或 hybrid pool/silo/bridge 架构，但必须保留全局索引、跨库 lineage reconciliation 和 audit trace。向量库、cache、日志片段或临时文件不得替代 canonical registry / audit ledger。
content.rationale: 本条不是数据库部署命令，不创建真实数据库，不强制单体库或分布式库；它只约束事实索引、审计账本和逻辑隔离边界。

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Feast documents point-in-time correct feature sets for training data and leakage prevention.
ClickHouse documents MergeTree family for large data volumes and high ingestion workloads, supporting high-frequency event store as an implementation pattern.
KX documents tick architecture patterns for real-time and historical market data capture, processing and analysis.
Iceberg supports hidden partitioning and partition evolution, illustrating that logical datasets should not be locked to one physical layout.
Binance documents separate futures market data websocket streams, supporting venue-specific market data stream modeling rather than one universal wide table.
Databento documents market data schemas and formats, supporting vendor-specific event schema mapping for market data stores.
CoinAPI market data documentation supports using vendor-specific market data contracts for candles, trades, order books, or related market data resources.
